svg.title: The week of outages
svg.desc: Calendar covering November 10 through 17, 2026, eight calendar days. Apple began outages on November 10 and 17; Microsoft on November 12; FAA and Workday on November 13; Chase and United on November 16. Workday recovery continued November 14. Microsoft's outage continued into November 13. Causes shown are those reported in the essay, with unknowns and the FAA investigation labeled. This is not a complete outage census.
